title: Fix the Missing Super Call
description: The program should define an Employee class that inherits name from a Person base class. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'Asha', the employee's inherited name.
actualProblem: Employee's constructor never calls the parent Person constructor, so self.name is never set. Accessing e.name raises an AttributeError.
explanation: When a subclass defines its own __init__, it overrides the parent's constructor entirely unless it explicitly calls super().__init__(...) to run the parent's initialization logic too.
